description: Curated fundamental OS/editing functions for coach search. Each entry resolves at runtime against the live layout CSV: if the combo is mapped, the result links to that key on whatever layer the optimizer placed it; otherwise the result shows as 'not mapped' with the raw host combo. Aliases make entries findable by the words users actually type.

fundamentals.name: Windows Search
fundamentals.explanation: Opens Windows Search: find apps, files, settings and web results from one box.

fundamentals.name: PowerToys Run
fundamentals.explanation: PowerToys Run launcher: launch apps, find files, calculate, search the web. Requires PowerToys running in the background.

fundamentals.name: PowerToys Command Palette
fundamentals.explanation: PowerToys Command Palette (CmdPal): the newer extensible launcher for commands, apps, files and window management. Requires a recent PowerToys version.

fundamentals.name: Task View / virtual desktops
fundamentals.explanation: Shows all open windows and virtual desktops; create and switch desktops here.

fundamentals.name: Task Manager
fundamentals.explanation: Opens Task Manager directly: inspect and end processes, check performance, manage startup apps.

fundamentals.name: Lock PC
fundamentals.explanation: Locks the workstation immediately.

fundamentals.name: Clipboard history
fundamentals.explanation: Opens clipboard history (must be enabled once in Settings). Paste older copies, pin items.

fundamentals.name: Screenshot (Snipping Tool)
fundamentals.explanation: Screen snip overlay: capture a region, window or full screen to the clipboard.

fundamentals.name: Emoji picker
fundamentals.explanation: Emoji/symbol/GIF picker that types into the focused field.

fundamentals.name: Switch apps
fundamentals.explanation: Cycle through open windows. Hold Alt, tap Tab, release to switch.

fundamentals.name: Close window
fundamentals.explanation: Closes the focused window; on the desktop it opens the shutdown dialog.

fundamentals.name: Show desktop
fundamentals.explanation: Toggles all windows minimized to reveal the desktop.

fundamentals.name: Windows Settings
fundamentals.explanation: Opens the Windows Settings app.

fundamentals.name: File Explorer
fundamentals.explanation: Opens a new File Explorer window.

fundamentals.name: Run dialog
fundamentals.explanation: The classic Run box: type a program name, path or shell command.

fundamentals.name: Snap window left
fundamentals.explanation: Snaps the window to the left half; Windows then offers what fills the right.

fundamentals.name: Snap window right
fundamentals.explanation: Snaps the window to the right half of the screen.

fundamentals.name: Copy
fundamentals.explanation: Copies the selection to the clipboard.

fundamentals.name: Paste
fundamentals.explanation: Pastes the clipboard contents. See also: Clipboard history (Win+V).

fundamentals.name: Cut
fundamentals.explanation: Cuts the selection to the clipboard.

fundamentals.name: Undo
fundamentals.explanation: Undoes the last action in the current app.

fundamentals.name: Redo
fundamentals.explanation: Redoes what was just undone.

fundamentals.name: Select all
fundamentals.explanation: Selects everything in the current document, list or field.

fundamentals.name: Find
fundamentals.explanation: Find-as-you-type inside the current app/page/document.

fundamentals.name: New virtual desktop
fundamentals.explanation: Creates a new virtual desktop and switches to it. Switch with Win+Ctrl+Left/Right.
